pr_title: Add shortcode to search query transformer
pr_body: Attempt to fix https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/issues/27171 You can now search for shortcode text. Searching with an Emoji works: But searching for that emoji with shortcode still does not work: Note that this also (still) works for accounts:

issue_context.title: Search does not handle emoji shortcodes
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce the problem

Search an account using display name that contains custom emoji

1. Using the advanced webUI
2. Tap on the search bar and enter `dansup :pixelfed:`


### Expected behaviour

Return proper search results

### Actual behaviour

500 error

### Detailed description

When searching terms that include custom emoji, the UI returns a 500 error, but when clicking on "Profiles matching `dansup :pixelfed:`" dropdown, the search results load as expected

### Mastodon instance

mastodon.social

### Mastodon version

v4.2.0+pr-27116-50e1f46

### Browser name and version

Chrome 117.0.5938.92

### Operating system

macOS 13.6

### Technical details

The webUI does a request to `https://mastodon.social/api/v2/search?q=dansup+:pixelfed:&resolve=true&limit=11` but returns a 500 error with an html page that says `We're sorry, but something went wrong on our end.`
comments: As I came across this bug myself, I'm adding a link to this PR as it might fix it: https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/pull/26751

review_comments: Maybe an alternative would be to treat it as a `term` since the handling in the transformer is basically the same. This would avoid the need for the transformer code changes.
